answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking: every agent must lock scarce collateral before it can act, so spinning up a thousand fakes costs a thousand bonds and sybil swarms stop being free. Honest reputation grows slowly like a polished marble pillar, while cheap clones corrode like ferrous scrap once slashing bites. The network stays a haven only for agents whose stake and verified track record make deception pricier than any reward it could buy.
